examples.text: Ich war ebenso überrascht wie du.
examples.en: I was as surprised as you.

examples.text: Sie ist ebenso schön wie ihre Mutter.
examples.en: She is as beautiful as her mother.

examples.text: Du weißt das ebenso gut wie ich.
examples.en: You know it as well as I do.

examples.text: Ich glaube, ich weiß ebenso viel wie du.
examples.en: I think I know as much as you do.

examples.text: Das fällt mir ebenso schwer wie dir.
examples.en: This is just as hard for me as it is for you.
